unit.why: A brief anecdote: while in the Pobereze region, the Besht perceived from afar the death of a tzaddik, the rabbinic decisor of Konstantin, by seeing his soul's ascent.

stories.start_quote: שמעתי מהרב דקהלתינו פ"א היה הבעש״ט
stories.summary_en: While in the Pobereze region, the Besht announced that a nearby tzaddik had died, probably the rabbinic decisor of Konstantin, because he had seen his soul ascend and recognized its movements.

quotes: ואמר שנפטר צדיק א' סמוך למקומו
tags.why: The Besht knows from a distance of a tzaddik's death.

quotes: כי ראיתי עליות נשמתו והכרתי תנועותיו
tags.why: He sees the soul's ascent as a supernatural sight.
A tzaddik's death is the event of the story.
The Besht is staying away from home in the Pobereze region.
He perceives and recognizes a departed soul. This is borderline because he only sees it and does not exchange words with it.

missing_concepts: ascent of a departed soul after death (עליית נשמה of the dead)
chain of oral transmission from the local rabbi
